property_summary: For any non-empty array of recipients and values, C.transfer must complete without reverting and forward exactly one well-formed transferFrom(from, tos[i], v[i]) call to the token contract for each i; the buggy version using i <= tos.length performs an out-of-bounds access and reverts, so it cannot satisfy this rule for any non-empty list.
change_summary: Change the loop condition from i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert when the array is non-empty.
